prompt: Concept art for a dark fantasy ARPG character select screen, a dramatic, exciting, premium game menu. Five heroes: an armoured crusader knight with sword and shield and a red cross, a glowing blue hooded wraith with a scythe, a winged horned demon in obsidian plate with hellfire claws, a small gnome warlock in a huge purple hat with green fel flames, and a red-hooded ranger archer with a recurve bow and a dire wolf. At the bottom centre an ornate info panel in dark iron and gold with the chosen hero's name, description, four skill icons and a Play button, and the title 'Choose your path' at the top. Painterly Diablo-style lighting, cinematic, high detail, 16:9 widescreen. Setting: a night camp in an ancient oak forest, the heroes in a half circle around a roaring bonfire, embers swirling up, rune stones glowing at the edges, lanterns in the trees, mist, the chosen knight stepping forward into the firelight.
